name: Hullsplitter Graveyard
introDiscord:
Ships lie crushed between Leviathan bones as though someone scattered
toys across the seabed.

Hullsplitter Lobsters have converted the wrecks into homes.

And apparently demolition projects.
introTwitch:
Ships lie crushed between Leviathan bones as though someone scattered
toys across the seabed.

Hullsplitter Lobsters have converted the wrecks into homes.

And apparently demolition projects.

hullsplitter-graveyard-approach.prompt: Three routes pass between shattered hulls and colossal ribs.

left.message:
A Hullsplitter Lobster tears a plank off a wreck.

It notices you.

The plank was apparently warm-up.

right.message: A strongbox has survived inside a ship that very much did not.

forward.message:
Shizuki's camp rests inside an overturned hull.

Her note:

'Sleeping in ship tonight.

Ship technically inside skeleton.

Trying not to rank weirdness anymore.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative supplies inside Shizuki's extremely nested
campsite.

hullsplitter-graveyard-depths.prompt:
The wrecks overlap until three narrow passages form between broken
keels.

left.message:
Star Candies are trapped beneath a Leviathan scale that crashed through
the ship deck.

right.message:
A Hullsplitter Lobster snaps a rotten beam in half.

It appears proud.

Unfortunately, you're next.

forward.message:
One Berry rests inside an old captain's cup.

Shizuki wrote:

'Promoted myself to captain.

Ship cannot move.

Crew is Glimmer.

Glimmer voted mutiny.'

hullsplitter-graveyard-threshold.prompt: Keelbreak Arena opens inside the shattered remains of several ships.

left.message:
A calm pocket forms beneath an overturned deck.

Shizuki's bottle:

'Captain recovery medicine.

Mutiny negotiations unsuccessful.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave Captain Shizuki's medicine untouched.

right.message: A pressure-sealed navigator's chest lies beneath a mast.

forward.message:
A Hullsplitter Lobster walks through the remains of an entire door.

Door loses.

boss-antechamber.name: Keelbreak Arena
boss-antechamber.prompt: An enormous wreck shifts inside Keelbreak Arena.

bossPromptDiscord:
An enormous wreck shifts inside Keelbreak Arena.

A claw punches through the hull from the inside.

Then another.

Use /yes to enter the Arena or /no to leave the demolition crew to its
work.
bossPromptTwitch:
An enormous wreck shifts inside Keelbreak Arena.

A claw punches through the hull from the inside.

Then another.

Use !yes to enter the Arena or !no to leave the demolition crew to its
work.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat.

Another section of ship collapses behind you.

boss.revealText:
The wreck splits open as a colossal Lobster tears through the keel.

Dreadclaw Hullsplitter reveals itself!

completionText:
The Dreadclaw retreats beneath the wrecks.

Shizuki's ship has somehow survived.

Captaincy preserved.
